native_install_mechanism: Repository custom instructions plus the repository SessionStart hook at .github/hooks/wcbs-session-start.json

fallbacks.subagents: Sequential self-review in a fresh context window using the exact base..head review package; report degraded independence.
fallbacks.browser_verification: Use command-line verification and record rendered-UI evidence as Not Run.

supported_runtime_versions: GitHub Copilot Chat with repository custom-instructions support
install: Commit .github/copilot-instructions.md, .github/hooks/wcbs-session-start.json, and hooks/. The repository SessionStart hook invokes the WCBS transport.
update: Edit the instructions, repository hook registration, Kernel, and hook files in the repository.
rollback: Restore the previous revision from version control.
limitations: No independent subagents and no native browser verification. The project hook path is structurally tested, but a clean Copilot runtime session is Not Run.
deprecation: Designed adapter; runtime activation evidence is pending.
